versos.texto_bv: Entre os bens consagrados estavam os provenientes de Aram e de Moabe, dos filhos de Amom, dos filisteus e de Amaleque, além do despojo tomado de Hadadezer, filho de Reobe e rei de Zobá.
versos.traducao_literal: De Aram, de Moabe, dos filhos de Amom, dos filisteus, de Amaleque e do despojo de Hadadezer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Variante textual: a BV lê 'Aram' (seguindo o TM אֲרָם), onde NTLH e NVIPT leem 'Edom' e ARA lê 'Síria' (=Aram). O contexto imediato (vv.13-14 tratam de Edom) e a LXX favorecem אֱדוֹם (Edom). A escolha entre Aram e Edom é questão de crítica textual que altera o referente geográfico, excedendo o escopo de revisão de forma. — evidência: NTLH: 'edomitas'; ARA: 'Síria'; NVIPT: 'Edom'. BV e TM: 'Aram'.

kjv.texto: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

vizinhos.11: Which also king David did dedicate unto the Lord, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
vizinhos.13: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

web.texto: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

vizinhos.11: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;
vizinhos.13: David earned a reputation when he returned from smiting the Syrians in the Valley of Salt, even eighteen thousand men.

versos.texto_bv: Davi ganhou renome quando voltou de derrotar dezoito mil arameus no vale do Sal.
versos.traducao_literal: E fez Davi um nome ao voltar de ferir Aram no vale do Sal: dezoito mil.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Mesma variante textual de v.12: a BV lê 'arameus' (Aram, TM), onde as três referências leem 'edomitas' (Edom, LXX). A mudança de 'arameus' para 'edomitas' alteraria o povo referido, excedendo o escopo editorial. — evidência: NTLH: 'edomitas'; ARA: 'edomitas'; NVIPT: 'edomitas'. BV e TM: 'arameus'.

kjv.texto: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

vizinhos.12: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
vizinhos.14: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
